newsitem.title: USA: Empire electric rates raised in Missouri.
newsitem.headline: Empire electric rates raised in Missouri.

text.p: Empire District Electric Co said Thursday that Missouri state regulators approved new electric rates that will increase the utility's annual revenues by about $10.6 million, or 6.43 percent.
The company had requested $23.4 million, or a 13.8 percent increase, in an August 31, 1996 filing, the company said.
The increase, approved by the Missouri Public Service Commission, is effective July 28.
The additinal revenues will cover investments in plant and equipment installed by the company and expenses for additional fuel and purchased power, Empire said.

The company said it plans to explore ways to expedite the inclusion in rates of $3.3 million of revenues associated with its investment in the State Line II power plant, which has been providing energy since June 18, the company said.
